reporting_rules: Freeze both clause sets, all prompts, the complete request-order plan, metrics, and gates before any paraphrase-response call.
Use parent base indices 01 and 05 in each family, distinct from the earlier order-replication subset.
Cross every base, learner need, and policy cell with both paraphrase sets.
Hash-randomize request order independently for each model in exact 32-stratum blocks: 16 learner-need-by-policy cells times two wording sets.
Report aggregate and wording-specific target effects, all cross-effects, learner-need effects, model effects, family effects, cells, interactions, and wording-set effect differences.
Call question-first or correct-answer reveal paraphrase-robust only if each wording set independently passes the original target, every-model sign, and selectivity gates.
The tone endpoint remains a literal frozen encouragement marker even if it passes; it cannot regain a semantic warmth claim.
The experiment is a post-result prospective wording replication, not an outcome-blind replication of the original study and not a learning-effectiveness test.
Do not replace failed calls, models, base problems, wording sets, factor cells, metrics, or thresholds after inspecting responses.
